stories.title: 两部门：在北京口岸开展进口药品通关电子化试点工作

en.title: Two departments: Launch electronic customs clearance pilot for imported medicines at Beijing port
en.summary: China's drug regulator and customs administration have initiated a digital customs clearance pilot program for imported medicines and medicinal materials at Beijing port to improve service efficiency and convenience.

stories.title: China tests first practical submarine solar power plant at 10 metres depth in the open sea

en.title: China tests first practical submarine solar power plant at 10 metres depth in the open sea
en.summary: Chinese scientists successfully tested the world's first underwater solar farm using perovskite-based photovoltaics at 10 metres depth, demonstrating that solar energy can power submarine operations in ocean conditions.

stories.title: 国家粮食和物资储备局：中国粮食市场保持总体平稳

en.title: National Grain and Material Reserve Bureau: China's grain market remains generally stable
en.summary: China's grain and material reserve authority reported on grain market stability during a briefing on safeguarding national grain security and managing strategic reserves.

stories.title: Suspected landmine blast injures South Korean soldiers in DMZ

en.title: Suspected landmine blast injures South Korean soldiers in DMZ
en.summary: Three people including South Korean soldiers were injured in a suspected mine explosion within the demilitarized zone separating North and South Korea during military operations.

stories.title: （长征胜利90周年）一名德国作家的长征寻迹

en.title: (90th Anniversary of Long March Victory) A German Writer's Long March Trail
en.summary: A German writer has undertaken a journey tracing the historical footsteps of the Long March. The report documents this writer's activities marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March.

en.title: Liu Fei, Deputy Secretary of Party Group of Linyi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, Under Investigation
en.summary: Liu Fei, a senior official in Linyi city's People's Congress Standing Committee, is under investigation by Shandong Province's discipline and supervision authorities for suspected serious violations of party discipline and law.

en.title: Strong explosion at Syrian military camp injures at least four
en.summary: A weapons depot in northern Syria experienced a powerful explosion that wounded at least four people, prompting officials to advise the public to avoid the area.

stories.title: A股午评：超4300只个股飘红，三大指数集体收涨

en.title: A-shares midday review: over 4,300 stocks gain, three major indices collectively rise
en.summary: More than 4,300 A-share stocks advanced with all three major indices posting gains. The pharmaceutical sector surged while semiconductors saw narrower gains and telecommunications, precious metals, and power stocks declined.

stories.title: Singapore nets US$862,000 from first auction in money laundering case

en.title: Singapore nets US$862,000 from first auction in money laundering case
en.summary: A rare Louis Vuitton and Yayoi Kusama collaboration pocketbook seized in Singapore's largest money laundering investigation sold for S$87,000 after intense bidding, generating nearly US$862,000 from the auction.

stories.title: 五部门印发通知 严惩生态环境技术服务机构弄虚作假

en.title: Five departments issue notice to severely punish ecological environment technology service institutions for falsifying information
en.summary: Five government bodies jointly released guidance to strengthen oversight of ecological environment technical service providers and crack down on data falsification, aiming to enhance market regulation and support environmental protection efforts.

stories.title: China’s collection of stock stamp duty jumps more than 80% as AI frenzy boosts trading

en.title: China's collection of stock stamp duty jumps more than 80% as AI frenzy boosts trading
en.summary: China collected 216 billion yuan in stock stamp duty between January and August, representing an 82 percent increase year-on-year. The surge was driven by a 72 percent rise in average daily trading values amid strong market sentiment and artificial intelligence enthusiasm.

stories.title: As Chinese consumption of gold jewellery slumps 34%, sellers look to markets abroad: WGC

en.title: As Chinese consumption of gold jewellery slumps 34%, sellers look to markets abroad: WGC
en.summary: Chinese gold jewellers are turning to Middle Eastern and Indian markets to offset declining domestic consumption. The World Gold Council reports that international buyers showed strong interest at recent trade fairs despite challenges from gold price volatility.

stories.title: Mainland China’s stock exchanges mount charm offensive amid Hong Kong IPO boom

en.title: Mainland China's stock exchanges mount charm offensive amid Hong Kong IPO boom
en.summary: Mainland Chinese stock exchanges are actively courting companies and regulators to choose domestic listings over Hong Kong. The exchanges have recently met with mainland firms planning Hong Kong IPOs to promote the benefits of listing domestically.

stories.title: Chinese AI chipmaker Hygon plots expansion from data centres to robotics

en.title: Chinese AI chipmaker Hygon plots expansion from data centres to robotics
en.summary: Chinese chipmaker Hygon Information Technology is releasing a new chip designed for robotics and other physical-world artificial intelligence applications. The product launch represents an expansion beyond the company's current focus on data centre chips.

stories.title: For China’s hi-tech IPOs, it’s Hong Kong vs the mainland – but how much does it matter?

en.title: For China's hi-tech IPOs, it's Hong Kong vs the mainland – but how much does it matter?
en.summary: Chinese technology companies choosing between Hong Kong and mainland listing venues face strategic options rather than a strict either-or decision, according to executives at a cross-border innovation platform. Both markets offer distinct advantages for emerging tech firms.
